command: SSH isolated-/tmp exact v1.0.4 wheel with a customized schema-0 config; offline doctor migration and command-inventory preservation checks
decisions: The exact v1.0.4 wheel ran successfully from an isolated user-space tool root while the host real legacy command inventory remained present and byte-identical.
The first non-billable doctor run migrated a customized schema-0 config to schema 3 and created one byte-identical backup; a second run reported current schema and offline diagnostics.
Operator comment, custom header, timeout, routing, permission, theme, and log level were preserved.
result: The migration and coexistence portions of UAT-002 passed on the exact v1.0.4 wheel, but the criterion remains Blocked until the immutable tagged installer itself performs activation over the real legacy resolution and the result is commit-bound.
limitations: The protected installer flow was not invoked before an immutable v1.0.4 tag/release binary existed, so PATH activation and installer cleanup guidance are not claimed.
No candidate commit is recorded before the v1.0.4 source is committed/tagged.
